result:
Round 202 is written and dispatched as CONTINUE. It re-runs SABA-B-4 stage 2 (one focus style on every store page), now carrying my ruling on the problem that stopped A in round 201. The advisor was available and I used it twice; I adopted its review fixes. Nothing in `store/` changed: HEAD is still `5b1a2bb` and the tree is clean.

**What round 201 showed.** C failed the round as "not implemented", because A stopped before changing anything. Removing the old focus ring from the "Choose video" control in `SfxVideoSync.tsx` would have left an invisible file input as its only focus target, so keyboard users would see no ring at all. That gap was in my round-201 task. C's RT-FIX check passed, so C-R200-01, C-R200-02 and the round-200 retro are closed. I corrected the wording C flagged (C-R201-02) in `lessons.md` L12 and in the retro (§3 row 178, new §10). No feature changed status, and gate 201 was skipped.

**Before ruling, I scanned the store for focusable elements that are visually hidden.** It found 6 sites; I ruled on each:
- **R98, `SfxVideoSync.tsx`:** "Choose video" becomes a real button that opens a hidden file input. The button gets the normal focus ring and keeps its current look.
  - I applied this, with the full token sweep, to a scratch copy: 27 test files (336 tests) passed and typecheck was clean.
  - In a real Chromium page, Enter, Space and a mouse click each opened the file chooser.
- **R99, `ProductCard.tsx`:** in the browser, all 7 "Play preview" buttons on the home page take keyboard focus while fully transparent, at 1280×720 and 1440×900. A one-class change makes the overlay appear while one of them has focus, the same as on hover. Filed as a Medium and fixed in this round.
- **R100, `VideoShowcase.tsx`:** the component isn't imported anywhere, so it never renders. C's check drops it, the file stays untouched, and it goes to the deferred Lows.
- **Header user menu (signed-in only):** its four items can't be reached with the keyboard at all. I filed this as B-R201-HEADER-USERMENU-KEYBOARD, Medium, and scheduled it right after this stage. It needs sign-in, so the browser half can't run in the cloud.
- **Two honeypot inputs:** already `tabIndex={-1}`, so not reachable; no change.

**Round 202 task:**
- **Scope:** same 31 files as round 201; three new files (two test files and implementation doc 160).
- **Expected scan count after A's change:** 16 tokens in 6 files. I measured this with the scanner on the scratch copy, so A won't stop on a correct result.
- **A's tests:** `store-focus-ring.test.ts` checks STF1–STF6 (STF6 guards hidden focusables), and `sfx-video-choose-button.test.tsx` checks SV1–SV5. Eight mutants must each turn a check red.
- **C's new checks:** a keyboard-focus check on the card buttons (HIDDEN-FOCUS) and a file-chooser check for "Choose video" (CHOOSE-VIDEO). If the scenes page doesn't render with the mock, its in-app half is BLOCKED.
- **C also re-checks:** "Browse the Collection" at 1280×720 after a ≥ 2 s wait. It was transparent on both of my probe runs, probably a scroll-in animation still running; that cause is unconfirmed.

**Bookkeeping:**
- **Archive:** the round-201 task is copied to `tasks/round-201.md`; nothing was overwritten.
- **Board and backlog:** `backlog.json` (v187) and `feature-status.md` are updated. RETRO 200 is now მზადაა.
- **Next queue:** Header menu, then SYS-1, SYS-2, SYS-3, then STORE-2b.
- **Not done:** no item is marked done without browser evidence. The next regression round is due on or after 2026-10-30.
- **Architect checkpoint:** I'll ask root for the frontend-architect checkpoint once round 202 passes. It won't hold up other work.

Full reasoning is in `b-round-201.md`.
